title: Occult Throne Ritual
description: A surreal black and white scene depicts a multi-armed skeletal deity with a crown of horns seated on a throne atop a dark mound. Hooded cultists with glowing halos kneel in a circle performing a ritual around a central fire and dripping pentagram symbol under a stormy sky.
prompt: A surreal black and white occult scene featuring a multi-armed skeletal deity with a horned crown and glowing rings seated on an ornate throne atop a dark mound. Below, several hooded cultists with halos kneel in a circle performing a ritual around a flaming brazier and a large dripping white pentagram symbol suspended in the air. Stormy clouds fill the sky with glowing orbs floating in the dark background, intricate linework, dark fantasy atmosphere.
